name: Legacy fields normalize into typed edges
description: Defines compatibility between existing relationship fields and the normalized typed-edge model.
summary: Legacy fields remain valid but normalize to typed edges: references/examples to mentions, tests to tests, verification_refs to verified_by, generated-artifact source_refs to derives_from, non-generated source_refs to mentions, section/document/members to contains, generated-artifact asset_refs to contains, and non-generated asset_refs to illustrated_by.
